demoBalances: Demo balances — the account pages below are placeholders and move no money.
layoutNote: Placeholder pages: forms validate locally and submit nothing.

deposit.intro: Bank transfer or payment gateway. Both stop at validation in this build.
deposit.demoBody: The form validated, but no request was sent and no balance moved. The live build posts makeBDepositV3 (bank) or makePDeposit (gateway) and waits for a reviewer.
deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.methodBankHint: Transfer to the account below, then upload the receipt.
deposit.methodGatewayHint: Redirects to the channel page in a live build.
deposit.receiptHint: PNG or JPG. Must show the reference number.
deposit.pendingNotice: Requests are reviewed by a human in the demo build too — nothing is credited.

withdrawal.intro: The first withdrawal each month carries no fee; later ones do.
withdrawal.demoBody: Validated and stopped. The live build posts makeWithdrawalV2 and the request appears under Pending transactions.
withdrawal.placeholderNotice: Placeholder only: no request is created and no balance moves.
withdrawal.title: Withdrawal
withdrawal.noBankAccount: No verified bank account yet — an account must pass a document check before it can receive a payout.
withdrawal.feeNotice: First withdrawal each month is free; later ones carry a small fee.

transfer.intro: Move money between the main wallet and a provider wallet before launching a title.
transfer.demoBody: Validated and stopped. The live build posts walletTransfer with an idempotency key, so a retry can never move money twice.
transfer.placeholderNotice: Placeholder only: balances shown above do not change.
transfer.title: Wallet transfer
transfer.auto: Auto-transfer to main wallet after each round

profile.demoBody: Validated and stopped. The live build posts setProfile, and setPassword separately when a new password is supplied.
profile.emailHint: Contact support to change the registered email
profile.title: Profile

history.intro: Filter the demo rows by type and status; the rollover block tracks active promotions.
history.title: Transaction history

pending.summary: {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} waiting for a reviewer.

pending.title: Pending transactions
pending.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? This cannot be undone.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.redeemPlaceholder: Enter the code from your message

actions.demoClaimBody: {what} of {amount} would be credited to the main wallet in the live build. Nothing is credited here.
actions.demoEntryBody: {needed} of your {held} tickets would be spent to enter. No entry is recorded here.
actions.demoEntryShort: You hold {held} tickets and {needed} are needed. The live build would send you to deposit or earn more.
actions.demoCancelBody: {reference} would be cancelled and any held amount released. Nothing changes here.
actions.demoInboxBody: “{label}” would be applied to message {message}. Nothing is saved here.
